## Change

What problem does this solve, and what will users notice?

## User check

For a user-facing change: the steps a user takes on Windows and what they should
see. Compare both sides when the change mirrors Windows. The release round runs
this check (see docs/RELEASE-ACCEPTANCE.md). Write "None" for internal changes.

## Validation

What did you test? For hardware-dependent changes, include the machine and candidate version, and say what remains untested.
